manifest_row.title: Documentary "Blowout" Follows Climate Cost of Oil Boom from Fracking to Exports

screening.main_topic: A documentary about the U.S. fracking and oil-and-gas export supply chain and its public-health, environmental-justice, and climate impacts.
screening.climate_relevance: The interview discusses methane leaks and greenhouse-gas emissions from oil and gas production, the climate effects of expanded exports, and whether natural gas infrastructure could delay a transition to renewable energy.
screening.reason: Climate impacts are a substantial part of the interview’s discussion of the film, including direct attention to methane’s warming effect, emissions policy, and the consequences of fossil-fuel expansion.
